sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
The tests pass with your original command, `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. It ran 2 tests, all OK.

The command failed for two reasons:
1. `tests/` had no `__init__.py`, so unittest wouldn't accept it as a start directory.
2. The `ledgerlite` package is in `src/`, which wasn't on `sys.path`.

I added `tests/__init__.py`, which puts `../src` on `sys.path`. That fixes both problems.

actions.command: env | grep -i ^PYTHONPATH; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -20
